name: Clean line comic
prefix: Create a comic illustration with confident ink contours, controlled line weight and clearly staged silhouettes. Use flat local colors with a restrained second tone for shadow. Keep facial features and costume construction legible at panel size.
suffix: Carry the same contour language, palette and shading logic through the whole image. Use expressions, gesture and framing to convey the action.

name: Watercolor & ink
prefix: Illustrate with transparent watercolor washes on lightly textured paper and selective, expressive ink lines. Let pigment gather at wash edges; preserve paper light in highlights. Use a harmonious, limited palette.
suffix: Keep faces and important gestures readable while allowing loose edges and quiet areas of paper around them.

name: Painted storybook
prefix: Create a storybook illustration with opaque gouache shapes, soft dry-brush texture and warm, intentional color relationships. Build appealing forms with simple light and shadow. Give the setting tactile details that support the story.
suffix: Unify figures and surroundings through shared brushwork and lighting. Keep the main action immediately readable.

name: Editorial collage
prefix: Compose an editorial illustration from cut-paper shapes, photographic fragments and visible paper grain. Use deliberate overlaps, crisp silhouettes and a small accent palette. Make scale and juxtaposition carry the idea.
suffix: Organize the image around one clear focal relationship, with enough visual breathing room for the composition to read at a glance.

name: Cinematic concept art
prefix: Develop a cinematic concept painting with a deliberate camera position, coherent perspective and motivated lighting. Establish foreground, middle distance and atmosphere through value grouping. Use material detail where it helps the focal story.
suffix: Keep color temperature and light direction consistent across the scene. Preserve a strong value structure at thumbnail size.

name: Pixel art
prefix: Create pixel art built from deliberate, crisp pixel clusters and a restrained palette. Describe forms through economical silhouettes, stepped contours and carefully placed highlights. Use consistent apparent pixel scale throughout.
suffix: Keep edges crisp and shapes readable, with intentional pixel clusters.
